Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Xros Heart] in its traits among them to your hand, and place 1 Digimon card with [Xros Heart] in its traits among them under this Tamer. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.[Your Turn] When you would play 1 Digimon with DigiXros requirements, by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.
